svg.aria-label: Charles Dickens is 1 of 19: going by punctuation alone, one of his 19 books is matched to him and stays on his shelf. Each of the other 18 flies to the author it was taken for: Robert E. Howard 5, Fyodor Dostoyevsky 2, Alexandre Dumas 2, Lord Byron 2, and one each to Jules Verne, Robert Louis Stevenson, Edgar Allan Poe, Jacob Grimm, Leo Tolstoy, John Milton and Charles Darwin.
svg.text: DICKENS: 1 OF 19, AND 5 WENT TO ROBERT E. HOWARD
Going by punctuation alone, who each of his 19 books was taken for
